title: snow stairs
description: simple resource pack that changes accacia, and spruce stairs into snow stairs.
body:
Changes spruce, and accacia stairs into the snow stairs. 
Any stairs or any texture that replaces the stairs would work using the same method shown in the resource pack.



![Laminate Floor 02](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/iODcvqeB/images/655131df190b6a0eb131fc27994e8c5308280b76.png)


for example to add more stairs copy same code model/block (3 files for each new stair)
then to change texture from snow to other block, change textures\blocks/snow_side.png into other texture but keep the same name.
